detail.longDescription:
Smart TV Remote Control brings TV controls and everyday Home screen tools together in one app. Use your phone to connect with compatible smart TVs over Wi-Fi, or enable the optional Android launcher for faster access to apps and useful features.

📺 SMART TV CONTROL

Turn your phone into a convenient remote for supported smart TVs.

• Discover compatible TVs on the same network
• Control volume and supported power functions
• Open supported TV apps and browse available channels
• Access a simple remote layout for everyday use

Remote functions depend on your TV brand, model, network environment, and supported capabilities.

📱 OPTIONAL HOME SCREEN

Smart TV Remote Control can also be used as your Android Home app.

When enabled, the Home screen provides convenient access to:

• Installed apps and TV remote controls
• Screen casting and flashlight features
• Web search
• Weather information
• Available news and content

Using the app as your default Home screen is optional. You can switch to another Home app at any time from Android settings.

⚡ EASY TO GET STARTED

Connect your phone and compatible smart TV to the same supported Wi-Fi network to begin using remote features.

If you also want the launcher experience, you can choose Smart TV Remote Control as your default Home app during setup.

🔎 SEARCH FROM HOME

The launcher includes an optional web search bar powered by Google, allowing you to search the web directly from your Home screen.

🔐 PERMISSIONS & PRIVACY

Some features may require permissions depending on how you use the app.

• Network access is used to discover and connect with compatible TVs
• Location may be used when you enable local weather
• Notifications may provide optional weather details, search shortcuts, and app-related information

You can review or change granted permissions at any time through Android settings.

Smart TV Remote Control gives you one convenient place to access compatible TV controls, apps, search, weather, news, screen casting, and other everyday tools.
